title: Design System: Food Label Health Agent

display.purpose: One concise consumer promise in the first viewport.

motion.name: proof-settle
motion.purpose: The user's evidence replaces the example package.

components.name: Editorial Primary Button
components.description: Compact dark-teal primary workflow action with directional offset depth.

components.name: Evidence Correction Field
components.description: Editable OCR field with visible confidence and uncertainty.
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:8px;color:#26334A;font:700 11px SFMono-Regular,monospace}.ds-field textarea{min-height:92px;border:1px solid rgba(38,51,74,.26);border-radius:10px;padding:13px 14px;color:#26334A;background:#FFFDF8;font:450 16px/1.55 -apple-system,sans-serif}.ds-field textarea:focus{outline:4px solid rgba(10,70,80,.22);border-color:#0A4650}

components.name: Tactile Upload Card
components.description: Functional Bento surface pairing a generic package reference with the real upload action.

components.name: State Pill
components.description: Compact workflow state, never a health conclusion.

narrative.overview: A warm editorial Bento workbench where a tangible package reference yields to the user's label evidence and correction task.
keyCharacteristics: One concise promise and one upload task share the first viewport.
A generic unbranded package demonstrates the correct capture surface without making claims.
Uploaded evidence replaces decorative imagery and becomes the visual focus.
Agent implementation details remain outside the consumer interface.

rules.name: Function Inside the Bento
rules.body: Every visible card performs upload, review, status, or recovery work.

rules.name: Evidence Before Interpretation
rules.body: The uploaded label and confirmed text lead; decoration cannot imply a health result.

rules.name: Chinese Line Integrity
rules.body: Chinese display copy is constrained by physical width rather than ch units.

dos: Do hide correction controls until OCR results exist.
Do pair uncertainty with explicit text.
Do let the uploaded label replace the example visual.
Do keep one primary action per workflow state.
donts: Don't copy the reference brand, assets, or benefits-product metaphors.
Don't expose LangGraph, RAG, MCP, or internal routes to consumers.
Don't imply medical clearance or absolute safety.
Don't turn explanatory filler into equal cards.
